name: Pipeline
description: People or deals moving through stages: hiring candidates, leads, proposals, orders, applications.

for: Sales leads or deals moving through stages on a board
Hiring candidates, client proposals, orders or applications in stages
Seeing the value in each stage and what the next step is
Dragging a card to move it to the next stage
notFor: Rows with a simple status to follow up (use tracker)
A one-off list to tick off (use checklist)
Invoicing a deal once it is won (use invoices)
